name: Mawntis
ability: Blindsight (its own: every move it uses hits) / Sniper (hidden)
look: a monstrous eyeless mantis with a large toothy maw, whip feelers, a spiky crest, big striped scythe claws with spines, six legs and a striped abdomen ending in leaves
entry: Its head has split into a maw full of fangs, and a second set of legs lets it run down prey in the undergrowth. It still has no eyes, but its scythes find their mark every time.
